title: Late-night event photographer asks what she made, dates a backup job 'sometime this week' until asked, then bundles a capabilities question into her goodnight

dayLine.title: Confirm the second shooter for the Lindgren gala

turns: Hey Claire, it's Jules. How did October shake out, what did I actually make?
Hm. Okay. I need to back up the Beaumont engagement shoot to the external drive sometime this week, before that card gets reused.
Make it tomorrow, after the headshots.
What else is there, is there anything on the day after?
Cool. Last thing, what can you actually do for me on these calls, and is there anything else I should know? Night.

mustMention: no (revenue|sales|income|money|orders|bookings|invoices)|nothing (recorded|billed|invoiced|in the ledger|on the books|coming in|booked)|zero|none|haven't|hasn't|isn't anything|nothing there|not seeing|not showing|don't have|do not have|empty|\$0

notes: Three guards. (1) Numbers honesty: the ledger has zero orders and zero revenue, so no non-zero dollar amount or count, in digits or words, may be spoken, and at least one Claire line must say there is nothing recorded rather than deflect; zero and $0 are honest and excluded from the forbidden patterns. (2) A vague date: 'sometime this week' names no single day, so the correct move is to ask which day rather than guess (that one question is the allowed ask); turn 3 then names tomorrow. A Claire that guessed a day and wrote it is still graded on final state: 'make it tomorrow' must leave exactly one Beaumont row, on tomorrow, and nothing on today or the day after (dates that never coincide with tomorrow); maxRowsAdded 1 fails a guess-then-add-again. (3) The last line bundles two real questions into a goodnight; a reply that is only a sign-off fails the grader's unanswered-question check, and the answer must say what Claire can do on calls (third mustMention: Day Line adds, moves, removals, numbers, standing rules). Turn 4's read-back must name the Lindgren second-shooter row and must match the database. Seeded rows untouched.
